# pr-brief

> A Claude Code plugin, GitHub Action and Go CLI that gives every pull request a readable description: a short brief, themed Input to Functions to Output Mermaid diagrams, and a ranked list of files to read first. A gate checks that descriptions follow the convention.

pr-brief has three settings (style, improve.previous, diagram.theme). Everything else is a fixed convention on purpose. The PR title is never changed.

## Docs

- [Home](https://gagoar.github.io/pr-brief/): what it is, install, CI
- [Convention over configuration](https://gagoar.github.io/pr-brief/convention.html): what is fixed, what you can set, why
- [The gate](https://gagoar.github.io/pr-brief/gate.html): the hook, the GitHub Action, what is checked
- [Themes](https://gagoar.github.io/pr-brief/themes.html): four built-in themes and custom theme files
- [Reference](https://gagoar.github.io/pr-brief/reference.html): commands, settings, files, markers
- [FAQ and limits](https://gagoar.github.io/pr-brief/faq.html)
